084        @Override
085        protected boolean create(MarketAPI createdAt, boolean barEvent) {
086
087                setPersonOverride(null);
088                
089                hector = getImportantPerson(People.HECTOR);
090                if (hector == null) return false;
091                
092                achilles = getImportantPerson(People.ACHILLES);
093                if (achilles == null) return false;
094                
095                hercules = getImportantPerson(People.HERCULES);
096                if (hercules == null) return false;
097                
098                hyder = getImportantPerson(People.HYDER);
099                if (hyder == null) return false;
100        
101                caden = getImportantPerson(People.CADEN);
102                if (caden == null) return false;
103                
104                macario = getImportantPerson(People.MACARIO);
105                if (macario == null) return false;
106                
107                horus_yaribay = getImportantPerson(People.HORUS_YARIBAY);
108                if (horus_yaribay == null) return false;
109                
110                reynard_hannan = getImportantPerson(People.REYNARD_HANNAN);
111                if (reynard_hannan == null) return false;
112                
113                fortuna_kato = getImportantPerson(People.FORTUNA_KATO);
114                if (fortuna_kato == null) return false;
115                
116                inesis = getImportantPerson(People.FARO_INESIS);
117                if (inesis == null) return false;
118                
119                arroyo = getImportantPerson(People.ARROYO);
120                if (arroyo == null) return false;
121                
122                rao = getImportantPerson(People.RAO);
123                if (rao == null) return false;
124                
125                siyavong = getImportantPerson(People.SIYAVONG);
126                if (siyavong == null) return false;
127                
128                /*maeus_moroz = getImportantPerson(People.MAEUS_MOROZ);
129                if (maeus_moroz == null) return false;
130                
131                standfast = getImportantPerson(People.STANDFAST);
132                if (standfast == null) return false;
133                
134                imoinu_kato = getImportantPerson(People.IMOINU_KATO);
135                if (imoinu_kato == null) return false;
136
137                arnaud_iscare = getImportantPerson(People.GA_RECRUITER);
138                if (arnaud_iscare == null) return false;*/
139                
140                sindria = getMarket("sindria");
141                if (sindria == null) return false;
142                if (!sindria.getFactionId().equals(Factions.DIKTAT)) return false;
143                
144                volturn = getMarket("volturn");
145                if (volturn == null) return false;
146                if (!volturn.getFactionId().equals(Factions.DIKTAT)) return false;
147                
148                cruor = getMarket("cruor");
149                if (cruor == null) return false;
150                if (!cruor.getFactionId().equals(Factions.DIKTAT)) return false;
151                
152                nortia = getMarket("nortia");
153                if (nortia == null) return false;
154                if (!nortia.getFactionId().equals(Factions.INDEPENDENT)) return false;
155                
156                umbra = getMarket("umbra");
157                if (umbra == null) return false;
158                if (!umbra.getFactionId().equals(Factions.PIRATES)) return false;
159
160                
161                setStoryMission();
162                setStartingStage(Stage.MACARIOS_PLOT);
163                addSuccessStages(Stage.COMPLETED);
164                
165                //setStageTransitionsRepeatable();  no.
166
167                setStageOnGlobalFlag(Stage.TALK_TO_CONTACT, "$sdse_talkToContact");
168                setStageOnGlobalFlag(Stage.TALK_TO_ACHILLES, "$sdse_talkToAchilles");
169                //setStageOnGlobalFlag(Stage.TALK_TO_HECTOR, "$sdse_talkToHector"); // use VISIT_RELAY for this
170                setStageOnGlobalFlag(Stage.VISIT_RELAY, "$sdse_visitRelay");
171                setStageOnGlobalFlag(Stage.WAIT_FOR_OPENING, "$sdse_waitForOpening");
172                setStageOnGlobalFlag(Stage.HECTOR_REVEALED, "$sdse_hectorDeclaredStageAdvance"); 
173                setStageOnGlobalFlag(Stage.HECTOR_REVEALED2, "$sdse_hectorDeclaredStageAdvance2"); 
174                setStageOnGlobalFlag(Stage.COMPLETED, "$sdse_achillesDeclaredStageAdvance");
175                
176                setRepFactionChangesNone();
177                setRepPersonChangesNone();
178                
179                makeImportant(achilles, "$sdse_talkToAchilles", Stage.TALK_TO_ACHILLES);
180                
181                beginStageTrigger(Stage.COMPLETED);
182                triggerSetGlobalMemoryValue("$sdse_missionCompleted", true);
183                triggerMakeNonStoryCritical(sindria, cruor, volturn, nortia, umbra); // maybe do this post-conflict?
184                endTrigger();
185                
186                //public static Logger log = Logger.getLogger(SDSevenSons.class);
187                
188                if (!setGlobalReference("$sdse_ref", "$sdse_inProgress")) {
189                        return false;
190                }
191                
192                return true;
193        }

200        @Override
201        protected boolean callAction(String action, String ruleId, final InteractionDialogAPI dialog,
202                                                                 List<Token> params, final Map<String, MemoryAPI> memoryMap) {
203                
204                if("titleCard".equals(action)) {
205
206                        TextPanelAPI text = dialog.getTextPanel();
207                        text.setFontOrbitronUnnecessarilyLarge();
208                        Color color = Misc.getBasePlayerColor();
209                        color = Global.getSector().getFaction(Factions.HEGEMONY).getBaseUIColor();
210                        text.addPara("SUPREME EXECUTOR", color);
211                        text.setFontInsignia();
212                        return true;
213                }
214                else if ("setCadenPoints".equals(action)) {
215                        int _points = Global.getSector().getPlayerMemoryWithoutUpdate().getInt("sd_trueBeliever");
216                        set("$cadenPoints", _points);
217                        return true;
218                }
219                else if ("sendDiktatSuppliedMerc".equals(action)) {
220                        //log.info("SDR_CMD now calling sendDiktatSuppliedMerc()");
221                        SDResolution.sendDiktatSuppliedMerc();
222                        return true;
223                } 
224                else if ("sendCompetingTTExecutive".equals(action)) {
225                        //log.info("SDR_CMD now calling sendCompetingTTExecutive()");
226                        SDResolution.sendCompetingTTExecutive();
227                        return true;
228                } 
229                else if ("sendLGKillFleet".equals(action)) {
230                        //log.info("SDR_CMD now calling sendLGKillFleet()");
231                        SDResolution.sendLGKillFleet();
232                        return true;
233                } 
234                else if ("sendLGKillFleet2".equals(action)) {
235                        //log.info("SDR_CMD now calling sendLGKillFleet()");
236                        SDResolution.sendLGKillFleet2();
237                        return true;
238                } 
239                else if ("startConflict".equals(action)) {
240                        SDResolution.beginStandoffInAskonia(dialog.getTextPanel(), true);
241                        return true;
242                }
243                else if ("fitCheckAchilles".equals(action)) {
244                        achilles.setPortraitSprite(Global.getSettings().getSpriteName("characters", "achilles_andrada2"));
245                        return true;
246                }
247                else if ("fitCheckHector".equals(action)) {
248                        hector.setPortraitSprite(Global.getSettings().getSpriteName("characters", "hector_andrada2"));
249                        return true;
250                }
251                else if ("makeHectorSupremeExecutor".equals(action)) {
252
253                        hector.getName().setLast("Andrada");
254                        hector.setFaction(Factions.DIKTAT);
255                        hector.setRankId(Ranks.FACTION_LEADER);
256                        hector.setPostId(Ranks.POST_FACTION_LEADER);
257                        hector.setImportance(PersonImportance.VERY_HIGH);
258                                        
259                        return true;
260                }
261                else if ("makeAchillesSupremeExecutor".equals(action)) {
262
263                        achilles.getName().setLast("Andrada");
264                        achilles.setFaction(Factions.DIKTAT_ACHILLES);
265                        achilles.setRankId(Ranks.FACTION_LEADER);
266                        achilles.setPostId(Ranks.POST_FACTION_LEADER);
267                        achilles.setImportance(PersonImportance.VERY_HIGH);
268
269                        return true;
270                }
271                else if("makeReynardUnimportant".equals(action)) {
272                        makeUnimportant(reynard_hannan);
273                        return true;
274                }
275                else if("updateImportantContact".equals(action)) {
276                        if (currentStage == Stage.TALK_TO_CONTACT) { 
277                                
278                                /*makeUnimportant(rao);
279                                makeUnimportant(siyavong);
280                                makeUnimportant(rao);
281                                makeUnimportant(inesis);
282                                makeUnimportant(arroyo);
283                                makeUnimportant(macario);
284                                makeUnimportant(fortuna_kato);
285                                makeUnimportant(horus_yaribay);
286                                makeUnimportant(reynard_hannan);*/
287                                
288                                if ( Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean("$sdse_talkFirstRao")) {
289                                        makeImportant(rao, "$sdse_talkToContact", Stage.TALK_TO_CONTACT);
290                                }
291                                else if ( Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean("$sdse_talkFirstSiyavong")) {
292                                        makeImportant(siyavong, "$sdse_talkToContact", Stage.TALK_TO_CONTACT);
293                                }
294                                else if ( Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean("$sdse_talkFirstInesis")) {
295                                        makeImportant(inesis, "$sdse_talkToContact", Stage.TALK_TO_CONTACT);
296                                }
297                                else if ( Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean("$sdse_talkFirstArroyo")) {
298                                        makeImportant(arroyo, "$sdse_talkToContact", Stage.TALK_TO_CONTACT);
299                                }
300                                else if ( Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean("$sdse_talkFirstMacario")) {
301                                        makeImportant(macario, "$sdse_talkToContact", Stage.TALK_TO_CONTACT);
302                                }
303                                else if ( Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean("$sdse_talkFirstFortuna")) {
304                                        makeImportant(fortuna_kato, "$sdse_talkToContact", Stage.TALK_TO_CONTACT);
305                                }
306                                else if ( Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean("$sdse_talkFirstHorus")) {
307                                        makeImportant(horus_yaribay, "$sdse_talkToContact", Stage.TALK_TO_CONTACT);
308                                }
309                                else if ( Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean("$sdse_talkFirstReynard")) {
310                                        makeImportant(reynard_hannan, "$sdse_talkToContact", Stage.TALK_TO_CONTACT);
311                                }
312                        }
313                        //else if (currentStage == Stage.VISIT_RELAY) { 
314                        //      
315                        //}
316                        return true;
317                }
318                else if("ensureAskoniaCommRelay".equals(action)) {
319                        
320                        // Make sure Askonia has a comm relay.
321                        askoniaCommRelay = Global.getSector().getEntityById("sindria_relay");
322
323                        // if it doesn't, and there's an empty spot, spawn it.
324                        // if it doesn't, and the usual spot is filled... replace it, I guess?
325                        if (askoniaCommRelay == null) {
326                                MarketAPI sindria = Global.getSector().getEconomy().getMarket("sindria");
327                                StarSystemAPI askonia = sindria.getStarSystem();
328                                for (SectorEntityToken objective : askonia.getEntitiesWithTag(Tags.COMM_RELAY)) {
329                                        if (objective.hasTag(Tags.NON_CLICKABLE)) continue;
330                                        if (objective.hasTag(Tags.FADING_OUT_AND_EXPIRING)) continue;
331                                        
332                                        askoniaCommRelay = objective;
333                                        break;
334                                }
335                                
336                                if (askoniaCommRelay == null) {
337                                        SectorEntityToken inner = null;
338                                        float minDist = Float.MAX_VALUE;
339                                        // is there an empty stable location? 
340                                        for (SectorEntityToken objective : askonia.getEntitiesWithTag(Tags.STABLE_LOCATION)) {
341                                                if (objective.hasTag(Tags.NON_CLICKABLE)) continue;
342                                                if (objective.hasTag(Tags.FADING_OUT_AND_EXPIRING)) continue;
343                                                
344                                                float dist = objective.getLocation().length();
345                                                if (dist < minDist) {
346                                                        inner = objective;
347                                                        minDist = dist;
348                                                }
349                                        }
350                                        
351                                        // if not, is there an objective we can replace?
352                                        if (inner == null) {
353                                                for (SectorEntityToken objective : askonia.getEntitiesWithTag(Tags.OBJECTIVE)) {
354                                                        if (objective.hasTag(Tags.NON_CLICKABLE)) continue;
355                                                        if (objective.hasTag(Tags.FADING_OUT_AND_EXPIRING)) continue;
356                                                        float dist = objective.getLocation().length();
357                                                        if (dist < minDist) {
358                                                                inner = objective;
359                                                                minDist = dist;
360                                                        }
361                                                }
362                                                if (inner != null) {
363                                                        LocationAPI loc = inner.getContainingLocation();
364                                                        SectorEntityToken built = loc.addCustomEntity(null,
365                                                                                                                                                 null,
366                                                                         Entities.STABLE_LOCATION, // type of object, defined in custom_entities.json
367                                                                         Factions.NEUTRAL); // faction
368                                                        if (inner.getOrbit() != null) {
369                                                                built.setOrbit(inner.getOrbit().makeCopy());
370                                                        } else {
371                                                                built.setLocation(inner.getLocation().x, inner.getLocation().y);
372                                                        }
373                                                        loc.removeEntity(inner);
374                                                        new Objectives(inner).updateOrbitingEntities(loc, inner, built);
375                                                        inner = built;
376                                                }
377                                        }
378                                        
379                                        // if not, let's try to create a stable location
380                                        if (inner == null) {
381                                                List<AddedEntity> added = StarSystemGenerator.addStableLocations(askonia, 1);
382                                                if (!added.isEmpty()) {
383                                                        inner = added.get(0).entity;
384                                                }
385                                        }
386                                        
387                                        // if we have a stable location: build a relay
388                                        if (inner != null) {
389                                                askoniaCommRelay = new Objectives(inner).build(Entities.COMM_RELAY_MAKESHIFT, Factions.DIKTAT);
390                                        } else {
391                                                // if we don't, I'm out of ideas
392                                        }
393                                }
394                        }
395                        
396                        if (askoniaCommRelay == null) {
397                                // we've tried everything, but no
398                                return false;
399                        }
400                        
401                        // set ID to match the original
402                        askoniaCommRelay.setId("sindria_relay");
403                
404                        // then set it as the comm relay to makeImportant!
405                        makeImportant(askoniaCommRelay, "$sdse_visitRelay", Stage.VISIT_RELAY);
406                        askoniaCommRelay.addTag(Tags.STORY_CRITICAL);
407                        
408                        return true;
409                }
410                else if(action.equals("makeRelayNotStoryCritical")) {
411                        askoniaCommRelay = Global.getSector().getEntityById("sindria_relay");
412                        if(askoniaCommRelay != null) {
413                                askoniaCommRelay.removeTag(Tags.STORY_CRITICAL);
414                        }
415                        return true;
416                }
417
418                return super.callAction(action, ruleId, dialog, params, memoryMap);
419        }
